gaps.explanation: Re-read p5-6 (Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds, GAAP) and the schedules p11-12 (Special Revenue Funds, Budget and Actual (Budgetary Basis)), p14 (General Fund revenues), p16 (Debt Service Fund, Budgetary Basis). Every printed revenue row of every fund column is already in detail[]: General Fund p14 lines add to 22,356,229 = p5 General Total revenues 22,356,229 (ties). The other funds come from their budgetary-basis schedules: Keno 208,218 (p11) vs p5 210,499 = -2,281; Street 6,836,068 (p11) vs p5 6,888,982 = -52,914; Incentive 2,894,745 (p12) vs p6 2,875,381 = +19,364; TIF 2,978,043 (p12) vs p6 2,983,043 = -5,000; Debt Service 2,996,195 (p16) vs p5 3,001,554 = -5,359. Sum -46,190: schedule 38,269,498 (= 22,356,229 + 208,218 + 6,836,068 + 2,894,745 + 2,978,043 + 2,996,195) vs statement Total Governmental 38,315,688 (p6). The statement fund-column amounts cannot be added without double counting the schedule lines for the same funds. No fix.

Same pages. General Fund p15 lines add to 19,284,852 = p5 General Total expenditures 19,284,852 and Debt Service p16 4,419,153 = p5 4,419,153 (both tie). Budgetary-basis schedules vs GAAP statement for the rest: Keno Community development 43,038 (p11) vs p5 General government 42,021 = +1,017; Street 2,707,253 (p11) vs p5 2,693,343 = +13,910; Incentive 2,930,315 (p12) vs p6 2,875,381 = +54,934; TIF 3,197,054 (p12) vs p6 2,983,043 = +214,011. Sum +283,872 = schedule 32,581,665 - statement 32,297,793 (p6 Total Governmental). No printed row is missing. No fix.

p5-6 Other Financing Sources (Uses): General - Proceeds from tax supported municipal improvement bonds 22,461,809, Original issue premium 882,542, Deposit to escrow to refund bonds (35,091,668), Transfers, net 28,190,463; Debt Service - Original issue discount (404,195), Proceeds from refunding bonds 49,505,000, Deposit to escrow (17,758,864), Transfers, net (27,897,181); Street - Transfers, net (293,282); Keno, Incentive, TIF '-'. Total Governmental (p6): 22,461,809 / 478,347 / 49,505,000 / (52,850,532) / 0 = 19,594,624. JSON debt_proceeds 71,966,809 (22,461,809 + 49,505,000) + other_financing (52,372,185) (478,347 - 52,850,532) = 19,594,624, correct as printed. Detail non-transfer other-financing lines: General p14 22,461,809 + 882,542, p15 (35,091,668); Debt Service p16 Proceeds from bond issuance 46,866,242, Original issue discount (404,195), Deposit to escrow (17,758,864) = 16,955,866. Difference 19,594,624 - 16,955,866 = 2,638,758 = the Debt Service budgetary schedule (p16) printing the refunding as Proceeds from bond issuance 46,866,242 + Transfers from other funds 2,638,758 (= 49,505,000) where the statement prints Proceeds from refunding bonds 49,505,000 and nets the transfer in Transfers, net (27,897,181) (p16: 2,638,758 - 27,897,181 = -25,258,423 vs p5 -27,897,181; both columns total 3,444,760). The Debt Service fund's statement proceeds row cannot be added (its money is already in the p16 46,866,242 line) and the 2,638,758 split is a schedule presentation, not a missing line; the only way to tie would be a derived figure. Every printed other-financing row of every fund column is in detail[]. The pass-2 relabel of detail[45] (Street 'Transfers from other funds' (293,282) labelled Transfers In) is withdrawn: an odd-signed amount on a printed 'Transfers from other funds' row keeps its printed label. No fix.
